lines.en: label ayanespecial1:
: Hey.
: What’s up?
: Oh, you know. Just...Ayane stuff.
: Are you...busy right now?
: I’m just watching Tsuneyo cook.
: Huh? Are you all the way in the old district right now?
: Nope. I’m at my house- where you would also be if you weren’t using your “secret girl powers” again.
: Oooooh...
: Yeah.
: Yeah, I’m feeling fine.
: But...I was actually wondering if you’d want to come meet up for a little while.
: So you don’t want to come here, but you want me to come to you?
: Right.
: Am I a delivery service now?
: Hahah...maybe.
: It really is only for a little while, though.
I sigh to myself and look over at Tsuneyo, who isn’t paying any attention to me at all.
I doubt I could get away from the house without things looking suspicious, but...
It isn’t often that Ayane actually asks me to come meet up with her in the middle of the night.
: Are you at your dorm?
: Nope.
: I’m at[school].
: What? Why?
: Hahah...
: That’s the weird part.
: I don’t really know.
: I just got this urge to come here all of a sudden.
: Well that’s not suspicious at all.
: I’ll start heading over now.
: Thanks...
: It really shouldn’t take long. Just tell Ami that you’re running out to buy them snacks or something and I’m sure everything will be okay.
: I kind of already botched that idea earlier by telling them to eat whatever's in the house.
: I’ll think of something, though.
: Okay...
: I’ll be on the roof when you get here.
: The roof? Why?
: The sky is all...pretty again.
: You’ll see when you get here...hahah.
Each time Ayane laughs, it feels as if she’s punctuating a sentence that she’s either resistant to utter or just doesn’t want to bother with at all.
It’s a strange type of laugh- nothing like the bright and jovial giggles I’ve grown accustomed to hearing from her.
It means she’s hiding something again.
I don’t want to make things sound like I’m some sort of magician who can just tell how people are feeling at all times-
But it doesn’t require a magician to discern the most obvious of verbal tics.
I heard somewhere that tics can be treated with medication, though.
So I utilize and accept my newfound role as the sole proprietor of Kumon-mi’s latest delivery service and offer up myself to her.
She will be fixed in no time at all.
: Okay.
: I’ll see you soon.
: I love you.
One of us hangs up.
: Tsuneyo-
: Go.
: I will inform the Emerald Guardian and the others of your absence.
: Dinner will be on the stove when and if you return.
: If?
: Tragedy could strike at any moment. You must always be prepared.
: ...Right.
: Anyway, I guess I’ll see you later.
: Perhaps.
: Goodnight, Sensei.
scene clearnightsky
I attempt to look up at the clouds once I make my way outside but see nothing at all.
Nothing apart from a few stray nebulas and the remnants of dead celestial bodies drifting haplessly through the air.
I, too, drift haplessly through the air.
I float through the streets of Kumon-mi, tapping my fingers against glass boxes encasing the bulbs of streetlights as if I were tapping extensions of a ceiling in the halls of an old[school].
A[school] I would have attended before my (?)  body had grown to its current size.
A[school] where I would have learned who I am or what I am or where I am or how I am.
A[school].
School.
That is where I’m heading.
I need to remind myself, as being this close to the sky is somehow distracting me from the order at hand here.
To meet with a girl who needs to see me now more than ever.
I wonder if we will have sex.
I hope that we will have sex.
I am happy when I have sex.
scene black
I close my eyes and allow my metaphorical wings to carry me the rest of the way.
What I mean by this is that I’ve walked the path so many times now that I don’t even need vision in order to make it there.
Or at least that’s what I think until I walk face first into a dumpster.
From that point onward, I keep my eyes open-
Proving once and for all that you can never see more with them closed.
scene nevermind1
Ayane Amamiya\nOccupation: Happy girl\nVaginal Depth: Medium-Shallow
She sits on a bench with a scarf wrapped around her that she had to purchase for herself because a man whom she would give her life for bought her friends one instead of her.
All she wanted was to match.
Some nights, she lays awake in bed, pondering over things those friends may have said to him while she was not around.
She worries that both of them are more compatible with him than she is.
She worries the same thing for virtually everyone else that she encounters, for sometimes simply hearing that the person you love loves you back is not enough to convince you.
She claims to have the blood of a warrior, but she is really just O-.
Giving to everyone, receiving from no one. And destined to lurk somewhere in the background until it is her time to shine.
Occasionally, she will glance up at the sky, wondering how much longer it will take for her “future husband” to arrive.
Unbeknownst to her, he is floating through the streets below, colliding with trash receptacles and attempting to catch birds.
He catches none, but several land beside her as she waits.
And waits.
And waits.
All the while, it grows.
scene black
I eventually arrive at the[school] and glance down at my phone to discover that it’s taken me relatively longer than normal to make it here.
I have several missed messages from Ayane, but see no purpose in responding to any of them as I’ll be seeing her any minute now.
I spread my arms out and part the[school] gates like Moses parting the Red Sea.
It’s incredibly effective because the gates were actually left open, and it enables me to feel much more important than I actually am for a brief moment in time.
I move through the[school].
I make it to the roof.
I open the door.
scene nevermind2
: Oh, good...I was starting to worry that maybe you were...abducted or kidnapped or something.
: I don’t really think it would count as “kidnapping” if someone my age was taken, so abducted works fine here.
scene nevermind3
: Right, yeah. I should have just followed my gut.
: So, you really weren’t joking about the sky.
: Crazy, right? It’s been like this pretty much every night lately.
: Do you know if this means anything for the weather? Like, is winter going to end early or something?
: Nah. The world is just coming to an end.
scene nevermind4
: Well, if that is the case, I’m glad that I get to share my final moments with you.
: If you’d have actually come to the slumber party thing, we could have all weathered the apocalypse together.
: But, Sensei, I don’t want to be around anyone else right now.
: I wanted to lure you all the way over here so I could adultnap you and hide you in a secret passage underneath my house and be together forever.
: Okay, well, this has been fun. But I’ve got to head out.
scene nevermind5
: Oh, stop. You know I’m only kidding.
: If that were ever going to happen, I’d abduct Ami, Maya, and Sana too so all of us could live happily ever after in my secret underground bunker.
: Sounds to me like it would get pretty cramped in there rather quickly.
scene nevermind6
: Probably, yeah...
: And that would make it kinda hard to have “private time” together, so...maybe I’ll have to have Geoffrey construct additional bunkers or something like that?
: Ayane.
scene nevermind3
: Yeah?
: You didn’t invite me here for construction tips, did you?
: I did not.
: Then what’s going on?
: This isn’t like you.
: I’m a [teenage]girl, Sensei. My body is changing. And along with it, my interests, desires, and even my personality.
: I find that hard to believe.
: How come?
: Because a good chunk of your personality is rooted in how much you love me.
: I can promise you that at least that much will never change.
: I don’t want any of you to change, though.
scene nevermind7
: Huh?
: Why is it surprising that I preferred the version of you that wasn’t using excuses to get out of everything?
: It’s not! I just...
: My heart skips a beat every time you look at me and say something like that.
: So hearing it will probably always make me gasp.
scene nevermind3
: I hope that’s okay.
: It’s fine.
: Now, tell me what this is really all about.
: Aww, come on. Can’t I use stall tactics a little more before we start getting to the serious stuff?
: Nope. I flew walked all the way here for you and I expect there to be some actual substance tonight.
scene nevermind8
: Even if it’s something you really don’t want to hear?
: If you pull the pregnancy trick on me again, I swear-
: Are you really that afraid of becoming a daddy?
: Yes. Now tell me what this is really about.
I want to say something about how the wind assaults us on the rooftop-
But it feels as if we’re already in space.
There is no wind anywhere.
There is no sound anywhere.
There is nothing.
: Can I have a hug?
: You made me walk all the way over here for a hug?
: Do you have any idea how much I love your hugs?
: Ugh, fine. Come here.
scene nevermind9
: Heheh~ Yes, [ayanemaster].
scene black
I’ve noticed something about Ayane over the time we’ve spent together in this strange excuse for a world.
Nearly every time she wraps her arms around me, there’s always an extravagant build-up first.
Kind of like a dog who is obedient enough to stay off of the couch until invited onto it-
But once it is, it leaps nearly ten feet in the air and crashes into the cushions with more vigor than a male rabbit during mating season.
I guess dogs can’t exactly jump ten feet, though.
That sounds more like a demon.
Either way, there’s no vigor at all in tonight’s embrace.
It’s more like wrapping my arms around a dying family pet that I’ll never get to hold again.
Its legs are shaking as it struggles to even stand up.
They snap- and all of the weight is forced onto me.
Everything always comes back to me.
I can’t stretch my arms around all of it.
scene nevermind10
: You’re warm.
: This is what you missed out on that night we went to the park with Sana.
: That was really hard, you know?
: If it were up to me, we’d be like this every hour of every day.
: That would make it very hard to perform necessary daily functions.
scene nevermind11
: But you wouldn’t have to jerk off anymore.
: Also true.
: I guess there are pros and cons to everything.
: I saw you once, you know.
: Saw me what?
: Jerking off.
: What? When?
: A really long time ago.
: Ami and I both saw it because we went to your room to see if you’d make us a snack and then...surprise. Penis.
: Was that before or after I apparently caught you two kissing one another?
scene nevermind12
: That...
: That never actually...happened.
: Well, apart from the Christmas party. But I was kinda just scrambling to keep things under wraps there and...
: You made that up?
scene nevermind13
: Yeah.
: Why?
: You know...
: I’ve been getting the feeling lately that you’re kind of just...going along with a lot of stuff.
: Like there’s part of you that’s just not really...there anymore.
: And I’ve heard you joking about your memories in the past, but like...then I started wondering if it really was a joke.
: What if parts of your memories really were gone and...weren’t coming back?
: What would that mean for me?
: When did the new memories start being recorded?
: Was it after I’d already fallen in love with you?
: And if so, how would that make me look?
: Needy?
: Desperate?
: Naive?
scene nevermind14
: So...yeah...
: I thought that maybe...if I could catch you going along with things that didn’t really happen...I’d know for sure.
: Ayane-
: It’s okay that you’re hiding things from me. I don’t need to know about them.
: I just wanted to know how much of what we have is real and...how much I may have lost.
: You haven’t lost anything.
: Everything that’s happened since the moment we became...intimate has been all me.
scene nevermind15
: Right, but...
: What about the moments that led us there?
: All of the...horrible feelings I felt...and all of the good things that came from meeting you and Ami...
: They’ll come back.
Maybe.
: And if they don’t?
: If they don’t, they don’t.
: There’s nothing we can do about it.
: But I’m here now, so just focus on that.
scene nevermind16
: Okay.
: There’s still...a lot more I want to talk about, though.
: Well, I don’t want to talk about it, but I kind of have to if things are ever going to change.
: Why do they have to change?
: Everything has to change. That’s how the world works.
: Change is so exhausting, though...
scene nevermind17
: I know it is...I agree...
: But...there is one change we kind of...have to acknowledge...
: And what is that?
: Sensei...
: You know that Ami is...actually in love with you, right?
: Like, not just as a [niece]. As a girl.
: I...don’t even know why I’m asking. Of course you know. It would be impossible not to.
: But, like...Ami is my best friend.
: And...I also love you...
: And I’m fine with keeping that hidden from everyone else, but...
: I kind of...want to at least tell her that it's not really one-sided anymore.
: That’s a bad idea, Ayane.
: Why?
: Because Ami would literally kill you.
: She wouldn’t kill me.
: I wouldn’t be so sure of that.
scene nevermind18
: I would.
: We might get into little arguments and stuff, but she’s pretty much my sister.
: And since I obviously know everything that’s going on with her, she should probably know everything that’s going on with me as well.
: And that everything is you.
: This is a horrible idea, Ayane.
: I’m sure it will be really awkward and confusing at first...
: But, in the long run, I think this is best for everyone.
: I...don’t know if anything has actually happened between you and Ami since you’re always so closed off and stuff...but I do know what’s happening on her side of things.
: She’s getting very anxious and nervous with all of these new girls showing up.
: And I’m sure that the two of us getting closer every day doesn’t help that at all.
: And you think her knowing that I’m fucking her best friend will?
scene nevermind19
: That’s not the part that’s important, Sensei. The important part is that our feelings for each other are specifically more than just sex.
: That’s what Ami’s afraid of- you leaving her.
: It’s the same exact fear that I have.
: Just...my fear has been getting a lot stronger lately.
: Because of Ami?
scene nevermind10
: Because of a few things.
scene black
We break apart.
Not emotionally, but physically.
Emotionally, it’s hard to say if a strong enough bond has ever formed on my end at all.
Let’s, in typical “me” fashion, turn this into a strange anecdotal metaphor.
I am a half-finished statue based on the outer layer of a real human being.
The process of turning me into stone is my relationship with Ayane.
I am poised and ready for my body to be covered in a thick coat of cement.
But the artists have only made it up to my knees before running out of whatever cement is made of.
Is cement even made of anything?
Is it just cement?
I don’t know.
I once again distract myself from anything but the topic at hand because I am afraid of thinking.
I am afraid of all things.
I am afraid of nothing.
I grow wings and fly away.
scene nevermind2
: So...umm...remember how I said I might need some more attention soon?
: Does this meeting not qualify as that? Because you’re already kind of acting out of the ordinary here.
: No. I’m talking about the...you leaving me thing.
: If you’re really intending to break the silence of our relationship to Ami, we should worry more about you leaving me.
: The things I mentioned don’t all involve Ami, Sensei.
: Well, can we at least fully address that part first? Because I still don’t like the idea of you coming out about this.
scene nevermind8
: Because you’re embarrassed of me?
: What? No.
: Because you don’t want to hurt Ami’s feelings?
: That’s closer, but still...no.
: Because you’re worried she’ll tell other people?
: Ayane-
: Because you’re worried she’ll tell Maya?
: What would Maya have to do with this?
: Remember the other day when I asked you about who you’d choose if all twenty of us were lined up in class and you were forced to pick one?
: I remember it being a flawed hypothetical scenario based on several of the students’ attendance, but yes.
: If that were true, and all of us really were in the same room, I think your choice might actually surprise you.
: That’s all I’m saying.
: You think I’d choose Maya in that situation?
: I just think you look a little differently at her than you do anyone else.
: I don’t know what it means, but I’d be lying if I said it doesn’t bother me.
: And that’s another one of your worries?
: That’s another one of my worries.
: I have a lot all of a sudden.
: I’m even here actually talking to you about my feelings for once because I’m so overwhelmed right now that I think I might explode.
: You should have come to my house tonight.
scene nevermind6
: I should have come to your house tonight.
: I don’t belong up here.
: I belong with everyone else...being loud and overly-expressive about the things I love most.
scene nevermind2
: But, most of all...with you.
: If the world really was ending tonight, I’d be scared. But, in a way, I’d kind of also be a little happy.
: Maybe the world ending would just mean that it starts all over again?
: A fresh start doesn't sound bad, does it?
: You'd have some of your memories back.
: I'd have both of my parents.
: And then one day, I’d bump into Ami and meet you.
: And I’d fall in love all over again.
scene nevermind5
: And then I’d catch you jerking off again.
: Why does that part have to come up now in the middle of a big, emotional moment?
scene nevermind2
: Neither of us are good at big, emotional moments.
: Maybe I learned it from you, but I think it’s easier to just move onto things that aren’t painful to talk about most of the time.
: Tonight is just...a special exception.
: I just want to know if there’s anything that can be done to make you-
scene nevermind3
: Ayane again?
: Yeah.
: I see, I see.
: All you really have to do is love me.
: I can do that much.
: And let me share those feelings with anyone that I think it’s safe to share them with.
: That one’s a little further off, but I could probably be swayed with a few more conversations.
: And accept that sometimes, there will be parts of me you wish didn’t exist.
: Fine. Whatever.
: And that sometimes, those parts might be hard to say out loud...so I’ll be forced to drop hint after hint after hint, hoping that you manage to understand what I’m trying to tell you.
: I get it. Yeah.
: Do you, though?
: Of course I do.
: Do you, though?
: Ayane...come on.
scene nevermind9
: Heheheh~
: It’s fine. It’s fine.
: I kind of expected things to play out like this anyway.
: It’s actually a pretty amazing quality being able to just effortlessly ignore the things you don’t want to acknowledge or hear.
: I always have so much trouble with that.
: Maybe one day, far off in the future, you can teach me how to be as intentionally dense as you.
: Are we done talking about serious stuff and just moving onto “insult Sensei time?”
: Is that what time it is?
: If you call it teacher time again, I’m leaving.
: Already? But teacher time isn’t over yet.
scene black
: Okay. Goodnight, Ayane.
Sensing that things are going to end here within a matter of moments, I turn around and-
: Wait!
scene nevermind20
: What is it?
: I don’t want you to leave yet.
: Then come back with me.
scene nevermind21
: I...don’t want to do that either.
: I mean, I do...
: But if I come back to your house, I’ll wind up telling Ami about us...and you asked for at least a few more conversations to be persuaded.
: I can’t just spend the entire night here, though.
: There are other people waiting for me.
scene nevermind22
: There are always other people waiting for you...
: And I’m okay with that. That’s just...the effect you have, I guess.
: It happened to me so...of course it would happen to everyone else.
: But right now, I...really need you to listen to me.
: Sensei..
: Something...
: Something happened and...
: And it's something I really need your help with and...
: I’m listening, Ayane.
: Whatever it is, I’m sure it won’t change anything between us.
: So, if that’s what you’re worried about-
scene nevermind23
: Nevermind.
: ...What?
: Nevermind.
: Don’t worry about it.
: I can tell you some other time.
: Just tell me now. If there’s more to the reason you called me out here-
scene nevermind24
: I just wanted to look at the sky with you.
: That’s all.
: I’ll stop telling everyone I’m not feeling well for real this time.
: And I’ll...keep doing my best.
: Just...try to be there for me if I need you...
scene nevermind25
: Okay?
: I love you...
: So...so much...
: Ayane-
: I’ll head home in a little while. I promise.
: I just want to be alone for a few minutes.
: Okay.
: I love you too.
scene black
My wings retreat back into my flesh and I’m forced to walk down several flights of stairs with the image of a crying blonde girl etched into my mind.
I don’t know what it is Ayane was about to tell me at the end...
But I’m sure that it will come up again in due time.
Either that or I’m just once again being “intentionally dense” or whatever it is she called me.
That doesn’t sound too far off.
I hope she’s okay, though.
I really do.
Just not enough to drop everything and be with her regardless of her plea for privacy.
Perhaps one day I’ll get there.
But for now-
I slide my hands into my pockets for the millionth time and go back home.
